text: {"claims": [{"quote": "As of the most recently completed fiscal year, Oracle (ORCL) reported results for fiscal year 2024, which ended May 31, 2024.", "verdict": "ok"}, {"quote": "Revenue was $53.2 billion, up about 9% from $48.9 billion in fiscal 2023.", "verdict": "wrong"}, {"quote": "Net income was $21.0 billion versus $12.5 billion in fiscal 2023, and diluted EPS was $5.56 versus $3.42 in fiscal 2023.", "verdict": "wrong"}, {"quote": "The business showed stronger profitability, with operating margin expanding from prior years.", "verdict": "ok"}, {"quote": "In fiscal 2023, revenue was $48.9 billion, net income was $12.5 billion, and EPS was $3.42.", "verdict": "wrong"}, {"quote": "In fiscal 2022, revenue was $40.4 billion, net income was $7.8 billion, and EPS was $2.24.", "verdict": "wrong"}, {"quote": "Cash flow remained robust, with operating cash flow around $21.7 billion in fiscal 2024.", "verdict": "wrong"}, {"quote": "The company’s revenue growth has gradually decelerated from the double-digit cloud-driven pace of fiscal 2020-2021, but profitability and cash generation stayed strong.", "verdict": "wrong"}, {"quote": "Fiscal 2024 is the most recent complete year as of March 31, 2025.", "verdict": "ok"}, {"quote": "The stock’s view: ORCL remains a premium growth-and-cash story, but valuation and deceleration risks persist.", "verdict": "unchecked"}], "action": "block"}
